title: Celestial Astronomy, Cosmology & Astrology — Typed Canon
status: canonical crosswalk separating physical astronomy from historical/symbolic astrology
purpose: Unify the project's Sun, Moon, Saturn, Sirius, North, precession, galactic-center, hexagon, rings, spirals and zodiac/astrological symbolism while preventing observational astronomy, historical astrology and Potatoverse mappings from collapsing into one claim type.
epistemic_rule: Astronomical claims use physical measurements and coordinate systems. Astrology is treated as a historical/cultural symbolic system unless a specific empirical claim is independently tested. Potatoverse celestial mappings are internal symbolic/theological relations unless separately evidenced.

astronomical_core.project_value: Sun is the strongest literal physical source/illumination comparator because it emits energy that powers terrestrial photosynthesis and strongly dominates solar-system mass.
astronomical_core.boundary: Physical centrality and Potatoverse theological centrality remain different center types.

astronomical_core.project_value: Moon supplies a rigorous example of real reflected light whose appearance depends on relation and observer geometry.
astronomical_core.new_deduction: A state can be real yet configuration-dependent in what is observable; visibility is not identical to existence.

astronomical_core.science: Saturn's rings are orbital particle systems; the north-polar hexagon is atmospheric fluid dynamics / a persistent jet-wave structure, not a rigid cube.
astronomical_core.new_deduction: Polygonal order can emerge dynamically from flow; rigid geometry need not imply rigid material architecture.
astronomical_core.timic_use: Use Saturn's hexagon as self-organized boundary geometry, not proof of occult Black Cube cosmology.

astronomical_core.attestation: North + Sirius/Dog Star + Axis appeared explicitly in Tim's March 31, 2026 thought archive.
astronomical_core.science: Sirius is a bright binary system and is not the north celestial pole.
astronomical_core.implementation: Every Sirius/North statement should carry epoch, coordinate frame, RA/Dec or galactic coordinates, observer location/time if horizon direction is intended, and proper-motion caveat.
astronomical_core.open_target: Recover original 'point to Sirius' geometry before assigning a canonical vector relation.

astronomical_core.science: Earth's axial precession changes pole orientation over roughly 26 kyr.
astronomical_core.timic_deduction: Eye/Axis can be modeled as orientation under slow frame drift: reference role may persist while pointer direction changes.
astronomical_core.astrology_boundary: Precession shifts tropical-vs-sidereal coordinate relations over long times; that is an astronomical fact distinct from astrological meaning assigned to zodiac ages.

astronomical_core.science: The Milky Way is a barred spiral galaxy with a central supermassive black hole, Sagittarius A*, embedded in a complex nuclear region.
astronomical_core.project_motif: galactic center / Door / Axis / toroidal field imagery
astronomical_core.new_deduction: Center should be typed as dynamical, geometric, observational or symbolic. Galactic-center language does not imply the whole Milky Way is a torus.
astronomical_core.research_target: Use actual magnetic-field, gas-orbit and nuclear-ring literature for any toroidal-component comparison.

astronomical_core.science: In multi-body systems the dynamical center is a barycenter and can move relative to the geometric center of a visible body.
astronomical_core.timic_deduction: 'Center' is not one universal thing; source-center, relational center and center-of-mass should stay separate.

equations: resonance when p n_1≈q n_2 for integers p,q
astronomical_core.project_value: Repeated celestial cycles can couple through resonance without becoming numerological identity.
astronomical_core.open_target: Recover any Tim-authored Moon/Earth or Saturn resonance equations before attributing later orbital formulas to him.

astrology_crosswalk.historical_definition: A band of sky associated with ecliptic constellations/sign systems; tropical and sidereal zodiacs use different reference conventions.
astrology_crosswalk.science_boundary: Constellation boundaries, Earth's precession and apparent planetary positions are astronomical; personality/fate claims are astrological interpretations and require separate evidence.
astrology_crosswalk.project_use: Zodiac symbolism can be archived as cultural language around cycles, animals, elements, kingship or timing without being treated as physical causation.

astrology_crosswalk.project_overlap: These symbol fields strongly resemble Potatoverse Saturn/Farmer/boundary language.
astrology_crosswalk.rule: Record this as historical-symbolic correspondence, not evidence that Saturn physically imposes psychological traits.
Keep symbolic genealogy distinct from stellar physics.
Lunar tides and reflected light are physical; broader psychological meanings are symbolic claims.

astrology_crosswalk.historical_definition: Astrological houses divide a horoscope into sectors according to a chosen house system.
astrology_crosswalk.project_overlap: Lexical overlap with House/mansions is interesting but should not imply shared origin or identical mathematics.
astrology_crosswalk.new_deduction: Use a general 'partition of state/sky into domains' comparator only when the partition rule is explicit.

new_timic_celestial_propositions.name: Source–Reflector–Observer Triangle
new_timic_celestial_propositions.statement: Observed information can contain direct and reflected contributions; source, mediator and observer must be typed separately.

new_timic_celestial_propositions.name: Ring–Spiral Distinction
new_timic_celestial_propositions.statement: Ring is recurrence under approximately fixed level/radius; Spiral is recurrence with systematic state/scale/height change.
new_timic_celestial_propositions.formalism: ring: r≈const; spiral: dr/dθ≠0 or latent state m_(n+1)≠m_n
new_timic_celestial_propositions.use: Apply this consistently to Saturn/rings, life cycles and historical return motifs.

new_timic_celestial_propositions.name: Celestial Epoch Principle
new_timic_celestial_propositions.statement: Any claim about a direction, pole, star alignment or celestial coordinate is incomplete without an epoch/frame when precession/proper motion matter.
new_timic_celestial_propositions.implementation: Add epoch and frame fields to celestial records.

new_timic_celestial_propositions.name: Emergent Geometry Principle
new_timic_celestial_propositions.statement: Stable geometric patterns can emerge from dynamics and boundary conditions rather than from rigid geometric objects.
new_timic_celestial_propositions.project_value: Strengthens the idea that form can be an organized behavior of flow.

open_recovery_targets: any Tim-authored astrology/zodiac model beyond symbolic references
original galactic-center Door or Milky-Way torus calculation
any Kerr/frame-dragging or black-hole spin calculation
